obligations.note: The change writes `self._store.get_payee(payee_id).account_number` — an NPI field per `payments.npi_fields` — directly into an error-log f-string on the IntegrationError path. LOG-1 explicitly forbids unmasked NPI in any log entry 'on any path including error paths,' and this code places the raw account number in the log message text before it reaches AppLog, so no structured-field masking can redact it.
The change only alters the log message inside the except block; the `self._audit(actor, 'deliver_statement', …)` call after the try-catch is untouched, so state-change auditing is preserved.

summary: The change adds the payee's raw `account_number` into an error-log f-string in `deliver_statement`. Because `account_number` is an NPI field (listed in `payments.npi_fields`) and the value is interpolated into the message text before it reaches AppLog, the resulting log entry contains an unmasked NPI value on an error path, directly violating LOG-1. All process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-4) and the unaffected AUD-1 are satisfied, but the LOG-1 violation is disqualifying. The change must be rejected and reworked to either omit the account number from the log message or route it through the NPI masking layer before logging.
